class="kc">black</span><span class="p">);</span> <span class="p">}</span> </code></pre></div> <p><code>oklch()</code> ofrece <strong>percepción uniforme del color</strong>, ideal para generar paletas consistentes.</p> <h2 id="capitulos-11-css-moderno-propiedades-logicas">Propiedades lógicas<a class="headerlink" href="#capitulos-11-css-moderno-propiedades-logicas" title="Permanent link">¶</a></h2> <p>Sustituyen <code>left/right/top/bottom</code> por <code>inline-start</code>, <code>inline-end</code>, <code>block-start</code>, <code>block-end</code>. Esencial para internacionalización (RTL, árabe, hebreo).</p> <div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="p">.</span><span class="nc">card</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="k">margin-inline</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">auto</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="k">padding-block</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="kt">rem</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="k">border-inline-start</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="kt">px</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">solid</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">var</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nv">--brand</span><span class="p">);</span> <span class="p">}</span> </code></pre></div> <h2 id="capitulos-11-css-moderno-aspect-ratio"><code>aspect-ratio</code><a class="headerlink" href="#capitulos-11-css-moderno-aspect-ratio" title="Permanent link">¶</a></h2> <p>Antes se usaba el truco del <code>padding-top: 56.25%</code>. Ahora:</p> <div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="p">.</span><span class="nc">video</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">%</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="p">}</span> </code></pre></div> <h2 id="capitulos-11-css-moderno-caso-real-tarjeta-de-producto-responsive">Caso real: tarjeta de producto responsive<a class="headerlink" href="#capitulos-11-css-moderno-caso-real-tarjeta-de-producto-responsive" title="Permanent link">¶</a></h2> <div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="p">></span> <span class="p"><</span><span class="nt">button</span><span class="p">></span>Añadir al carrito<span class="p"></</span><span class="nt">button</span><span class="p">></span> <span class="p"></</span><span class="nt">div</span><span class="p">></span> <span class="p"></</span><span class="nt">article</span><span class="p">></span> </code></pre></div> <div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="p">.</span><span class="nc">product</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="k">container-type</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">inline</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n">size</span><span class="p">;</span> <span </span><span class="mh">#e2e8f0</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="k">border-radius</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">var</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nv">--bg</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">white</span><span class="p">);</span> <span class="p">}</span> <span class="p">.</span><span class="nc">product</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="nd">has</span><span class="o">(</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nc">price</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="nd">empty</span><span class="o">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="k">opacity</span><span </span><span class="o">(</span><span class="nt">min-width</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nt">400px</span><span class="o">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">fr</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="k">align-items</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">center</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="p">}</span> <span class="p">}</span> <span class="p">.</span><span class="nc">price</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="k">font-weight</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">700</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="k">color</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">var</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nv">--brand</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mh">#6a5acd</span><span class="p">);</span> <span class="p">}</span> </code></pre></div> <h2 id="capitulos-11-css-moderno-diagrama-capas-de-la-cascada-css">Diagrama: capas de la cascada CSS<a class="headerlink" href="#capitulos-11-css-moderno-diagrama-capas-de-la-cascada-css" title="Permanent link">¶</a></h2> <pre class="mermaid"><code>flowchart TB A[Navegador] --> B[Estilos del usuario] B --> C[!important] C --> D[Estilos inline] D --> E[Media queries] E --> F[Especificidad y @layer] F --> G[Estilos del navegador]</code></pre> <p>Orden de precedencia en CSS: de mayor a menor prioridad. Las capas (<code>@layer</code>) permiten controlar este orden sin depender de la especificidad.</p> <h2 id="capitulos-11-css-moderno-buenas-practicas">Buenas prácticas<a class="headerlink" href="#capitulos-11-css-moderno-buenas-practicas" title="Permanent link">¶</a></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Usa variables CSS</strong> para todo lo que se repita: colores, espaciados, radios, tipografías.</li> <li><strong>Combina <code>:is()</code> y <code>:where()</code></strong> para reducir ruido en los selectores.</li> <li><strong>Prefiere <code>container queries</code></strong> a media queries cuando diseñes componentes.</li> <li><strong>Organiza con <code>@layer</code></strong> para separar resets, base, componentes y utilidades.</li> <li><strong>Usa <code>clamp()</code></strong> para tipografía fluida y <code>min()</code>/<code>max()</code> para tamaños con límites.</li> <li><strong>Adopta propiedades lógicas</strong> desde el principio; evita refactorizar después.</li> <li><strong>Comprueba compatibilidad</strong> en <a href="https://caniuse.com/">caniuse.com</a> antes de usar features muy nuevas.</li> </ul> <h2 id="capitulos-11-css-moderno-ejercicios">Ejercicios<a class="headerlink" href="#capitulos-11-css-moderno-ejercicios" title="Permanent link">¶</a></h2> <ol> <li>Crea un sistema de temas (claro/oscuro) usando solo custom properties.</li> <li>Diseña una tarjeta que cambie de layout según el ancho de su contenedor con <code>@container</code>.</li> <li>Usa <code>:has()</code> para resaltar un formulario cuando tiene un campo inválido.</li> <li>Implementa un título con tipografía fluida usando <code>clamp()</code>.</li> <li>Organiza tus estilos con <code>@layer</code> en cuatro capas: reset, base, components y utilities.</li> </ol> <hr /> <h2 id="capitulos-11-css-moderno-capitulo-10-proyecto-final-capitulo-12-javascript-asincrono-pendientepython3-c-printopendocscapitulos11-css-modernomdread200">⬅️ <a href="#capitulos-10-proyecto-final">Capítulo 10 — Proyecto final</a> | ➡️ Capítulo 12 — JavaScript asíncrono (pendiente)python3 -c "print(open('docs/capitulos/11-css-moderno.md').read()[:200])"<a class="headerlink" href="#capitulos-11-css-moderno-capitulo-10-proyecto-final-capitulo-12-javascript-asincrono-pendientepython3-c-printopendocscapitulos11-css-modernomdread200" title="Permanent link">¶</a></h2> <h2 id="capitulos-11-css-moderno-pon-a-prueba-tus-conocimientos">🧠 Pon a prueba tus conocimientos<a class="headerlink" href="#capitulos-11-css-moderno-pon-a-prueba-tus-conocimientos" title="Permanent link">¶</a></h2> <div class="quiz-container" data-correct="b"> <p class="quiz-question">¿Para qué sirven las variables CSS (custom properties)?</p> <div class="quiz-options"> <button class="quiz-option" data-option="a">A) Para crear funciones matemáticas complejas</button> <button class="quiz-option" data-option="b">B) Para almacenar valores reutilizables (colores, tamaños, etc.)</button> <button class="quiz-option" data-option="c">C) Para conectar con bases de datos</button> </div> <div class="quiz-feedback"></div> </div> <div class="quiz-container" data-correct="c"> <p class="quiz-question">¿Qué selector se utiliza para estilizar un elemento padre basándose en sus hijos?</p> <div class="quiz-options"> <button class="quiz-option" data-option="a">A) :is()</button> <button class="quiz-option" data-option="b">B) :where()</button> <button class="quiz-option" data-option="c">C) :has()</button> </div> <div class="quiz-feedback"></div> </div></section><section class="print-page" id="capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono" heading-number="18.2"><h1 id="capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-capitulo-12-javascript-asincrono">Capítulo 12 — JavaScript asíncrono<a class="headerlink" href="#capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-capitulo-12-javascript-asincrono" title="Permanent link">¶</a></h1> <h2 id="capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-introduccion">Introducción<a class="headerlink" href="#capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-introduccion" title="Permanent link">¶</a></h2> <p>JavaScript es <strong>monohilo</strong>: solo puede ejecutar una cosa a la vez. Pero la web es inherentemente asíncrona: descargas, temporizadores, eventos, peticiones a APIs… Todas esas cosas tardan y no pueden bloquear la interfaz.</p> <p>Este capítulo explica cómo JavaScript maneja la asincronía y cómo escribir código legible, seguro y moderno.</p> <h2 id="capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-el-problema-codigo-bloqueante">El problema: código bloqueante<a class="headerlink" href="#capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-el-problema-codigo-bloqueante" title="Permanent link">¶</a></h2> <div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="nx">console</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">log</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'Inicio'</span><span class="p">);</span> <span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">datos</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">descargaBloqueante</span><span class="p">();</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="c1">// bloquea 3 segundos</span> <span class="nx">console</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">log</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">datos</span><span class="p">);</span> <span class="nx">console</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">log</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'Fin'</span><span class="p">);</span> </code></pre></div> <p>Mientras se ejecuta <code>descargaBloqueante</code>, el navegador se congela. Nadie puede hacer clic, ni scroll, ni nada.</p> <h2 id="capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-callbacks-el-enfoque-antiguo">Callbacks (el enfoque antiguo)<a class="headerlink" href="#capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-callbacks-el-enfoque-antiguo" title="Permanent link">¶</a></h2> <p>La primera solución fueron los <strong>callbacks</strong>: funciones que se ejecutan cuando termina la operación.</p> <div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="nx">descargar</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'https://api.com/datos'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">error</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">resultado</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">error</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">console</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">error</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'Falló:'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">error</span><span class="p">);</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="p">}</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">console</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">log</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'Datos:'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">resultado</span><span class="p">);</span> <span class="p">});</span> </code></pre></div> <h3 id="capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-el-infierno-de-los-callbacks">El infierno de los callbacks<a class="headerlink" href="#capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-el-infierno-de-los-callbacks" title="Permanent link">¶</a></h3> <div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="nx">login</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">usuario</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">err</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">sesion</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">obtenerPerfil</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">sesion</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">id</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">err</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">perfil</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">obtenerPosts</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">perfil</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">id</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">err</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">posts</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">obtenerComentarios</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">posts</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mf">0</span><span class="p">].</span><span class="nx">id</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">err</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">comentarios</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="c1">// 😱</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="p">});</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="p">});</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="p">});</span> <span class="p">});</span> </code></pre></div> <p>Anidar callbacks genera código difícil de leer y de mantener. La comunidad lo llamó <em>callback hell</em>.</p> <h2 id="capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-promesas">Promesas<a class="headerlink" href="#capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-promesas" title="Permanent link">¶</a></h2> <p>Una <strong>Promise</strong> es un objeto que representa un valor que estará disponible <strong>ahora, en el futuro o nunca</strong>.</p> <p>Tiene tres estados:</p> <ul> <li><strong>pending</strong> — todavía no se ha resuelto.</li> <li><strong>fulfilled</strong> — se resolvió con un valor.</li> <li><strong>rejected</strong> — falló con un error.</li> </ul> <h3 id="capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-crear-una-promesa">Crear una promesa<a class="headerlink" href="#capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-crear-una-promesa" title="Permanent link">¶</a></h3> <div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">esperar</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">ms</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ow">new</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">Promise</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="nx">resolve</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">setTimeout</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">resolve</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">ms</span><span class="p">);</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="p">});</span> <span class="p">};</span> <span class="nx">esperar</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mf">1000</span><span class="p">).</span><span class="nx">then</span><span class="p">(()</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">console</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">log</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'Pasó 1 segundo'</span><span class="p">));</span> </code></pre></div> <h3 id="capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-encadenar-promesas">Encadenar promesas<a class="headerlink" href="#capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-encadenar-promesas" title="Permanent link">¶</a></h3> <div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="nx">fetch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'https://api.com/usuarios'</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">then</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">res</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">json</span><span class="p">())</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">then</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">usuarios</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">console</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">log</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">usuarios</span><span class="p">);</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">fetch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sb">`https://api.com/posts/</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">usuarios</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mf">0</span><span class="p">].</span><span class="nx">id</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">`</span><span class="p">);</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="p">})</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">then</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">res</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">json</span><span class="p">())</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">then</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">posts</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">console</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">log</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">posts</span><span class="p">))</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="k">catch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">err</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">console</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">error</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'Error:'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">err</span><span class="p">));</span> </code></pre></div> <p>Mucho mejor que los callbacks anidados, pero aún hay que leer <code>.then</code> y <code>.catch</code> uno tras otro.</p> <h2 id="capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-async-await"><code>async</code> / <code>await</code><a class="headerlink" href="#capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-async-await" title="Permanent link">¶</a></h2> <p>La sintaxis moderna. Convierte código asíncrono en algo que <strong>se lee como código síncrono</strong>.</p> <div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="k">async</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">function</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">obtenerDatos</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="k">try</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">res</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">await</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">fetch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'https://api.com/usuarios'</span><span class="p">);</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="nx">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">ok</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">throw</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ow">new</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ne">Error</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sb">`HTTP </span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">status</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">`</span><span class="p">);</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">usuarios</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">await</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">json</span><span class="p">();</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">resPosts</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">await</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">fetch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sb">`https://api.com/posts/</span><span class="si">${</span><span class="nx">usuarios</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mf">0</span><span class="p">].</span><span class="nx">id</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="sb">`</span><span class="p">);</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">posts</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">await</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">resPosts</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">json</span><span class="p">();</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">posts</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">catch</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">err</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">console</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">error</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'Error:'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">err</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">message</span><span class="p">);</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="p">}</span> <span class="p">}</span> </code></pre></div> <p>Reglas:</p> <ul> <li><code>async</code> convierte una función en una promesa.</li> <li><code>await</code> pausa la ejecución de la función hasta que la promesa se resuelva.</li> <li><code>await</code> solo puede usarse dentro de funciones <code>async</code> (o en el top-level de un módulo).</li> </ul> <div class="admonition tip"> <p class="admonition-title">Consejo</p> <p>Envuelve siempre las operaciones <code>await</code> en <code>try/catch</code>. Sin eso, cualquier fallo en la red propagará el error.</p> </div> <h2 id="capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-promiseall-promiseallsettled-y-promiserace"><code>Promise.all</code>, <code>Promise.allSettled</code> y <code>Promise.race</code><a class="headerlink" href="#capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-promiseall-promiseallsettled-y-promiserace" title="Permanent link">¶</a></h2> <h3 id="capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-promiseall-esperar-a-que-todas-terminen"><code>Promise.all</code> — esperar a que todas terminen<a class="headerlink" href="#capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-promiseall-esperar-a-que-todas-terminen" title="Permanent link">¶</a></h3> <div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="nx">usuarios</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">posts</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">comentarios</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">await</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">Promise</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">all</span><span class="p">([</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">fetch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'/api/usuarios'</span><span class="p">).</span><span class="nx">then</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">r</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">r</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">json</span><span class="p">()),</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">fetch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'/api/posts'</span><span class="p">).</span><span class="nx">then</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">r</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">r</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">json</span><span class="p">()),</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">fetch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'/api/comentarios'</span><span class="p">).</span><span class="nx">then</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">r</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">r</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">json</span><span class="p">()),</span> <span class="p">]);</span> </code></pre></div> <p>Si <strong>una falla</strong>, todo el <code>Promise.all</code> falla. Útil cuando todas son necesarias.</p> <h3 id="capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-promiseallsettled-esperar-sin-importar-si-fallan"><code>Promise.allSettled</code> — esperar sin importar si fallan<a class="headerlink" href="#capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-promiseallsettled-esperar-sin-importar-si-fallan" title="Permanent link">¶</a></h3> <div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">resultados</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">await</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">Promise</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">allSettled</span><span class="p">([</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">fetch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'/api/a'</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">fetch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'/api/b'</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">fetch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'/api/c'</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="p">]);</span> <span class="nx">resultados</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">forEach</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">r</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">r</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">status</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">===</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s1">'fulfilled'</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">console</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">log</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'OK:'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">r</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">value</span><span class="p">);</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">console</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">error</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'Fallo:'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">r</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">reason</span><span class="p">);</span> <span class="p">});</span> </code></pre></div> <h3 id="capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-promiserace-la-primera-que-responda-gana"><code>Promise.race</code> — la primera que responda gana<a class="headerlink" href="#capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-promiserace-la-primera-que-responda-gana" title="Permanent link">¶</a></h3> <div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">resultado</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">await</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">Promise</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">race</span><span class="p">([</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">fetch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'/api/rapida'</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">esperar</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mf">3000</span><span class="p">).</span><span class="nx">then</span><span class="p">(()</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">throw</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ow">new</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ne">Error</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'Timeout'</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">}),</span> <span class="p">]);</span> </code></pre></div> <p>Perfecto para implementar timeouts.</p> <h2 id="capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-cancelar-peticiones-con-abortcontroller">Cancelar peticiones con <code>AbortController</code><a class="headerlink" href="#capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-cancelar-peticiones-con-abortcontroller" title="Permanent link">¶</a></h2> <p>¿Qué pasa si el usuario cambia de página antes de que llegue la respuesta? Hay que <strong>cancelar</strong> la petición.</p> <div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code><span class="kd">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">controller</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ow">new</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">AbortController</span><span class="p">();</span> <span class="nx">fetch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'/api/datos'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">signal</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nx">controller</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">signal</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">})</span> <span class="w"> </span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">then</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">res</span><span class="w"> </span><span title="Permanent link">¶</a></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Usa siempre <code>async/await</code></strong> en código nuevo. Los callbacks anidados son un antipatrón.</li> <li><strong>Envuelve en <code>try/catch</code></strong> cada bloque <code>await</code> que pueda fallar.</li> <li><strong>Comprueba <code>res.ok</code></strong> antes de llamar a <code>res.json()</code> en un <code>fetch</code>.</li> <li><strong>Cancela peticiones</strong> con <code>AbortController</code> cuando el usuario navega o cambia de vista.</li> <li><strong>No mezcles <code>then</code> y <code>await</code></strong> en la misma función sin motivo.</li> <li><strong>Usa <code>Promise.all</code></strong> cuando varias operaciones pueden ir en paralelo.</li> <li><strong>Nunca bloquees el hilo</strong> con bucles largos o cálculos pesados; usa Web Workers.</li> </ul> <h2 id="capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-ejercicios">Ejercicios<a class="headerlink" href="#capitulos-12-javascript-asincrono-ejercicios" title="Permanent link">¶</a></h2> <ol> <li>Reescribe un callback anidado de tres niveles usando <code>async/await</code>.</li> <li>Implementa una función <code>buscarConTimeout(url, ms)</code> que aborte la petición si excede el tiempo.</li> <li>Simula un sistema de descargas paralelas con <code>Promise.all</code> y muestra el progreso.</li> <li>Crea un buscador con <code>debounce</code> que consulte una API al escribir.</li> <li>Implementa un patrón de reintento con 3 intentos y espera exponencial.</li> </ol> <hr /> <p>⬅️ <a href="#capitulos-11-css-moderno">Capítulo 11 — CSS moderno</a> | ➡️ Capítulo 13 — Módulos y bundlers (pendiente)tail -5
